categories.title: Linoprint
categories.description: Hand-cut relief prints carved from linoleum — dense ink, bold contrast, and the slow rhythm of the blade. Each edition is printed by hand.

categories.title: Paintings
categories.description: Acrylic and mixed media on canvas — figurative work exploring the body, intimacy, and colour as emotional register. Small formats and large gestures.

categories.title: Commissions
categories.description: Unique pieces made for collectors and clients — portraits, symbolic imagery, and personal narratives rendered in Larissa's visual language.

categories.title: Brand & Design
categories.description: Visual identities, logos and stationery for small brands, makers and musicians — drawn with the same hand as the paintings and prints.

works.title: Mini Canvas Series
works.description: Four small-format paintings that together form one meditation on circular form and warm colour. Geometric arcs in roasted pink and dusty lavender — quiet, repetitive, contemplative.
works.alt: Mini canvas series in roasted pink

works.title: The Eye
works.technique: Oil and mixed media on canvas
works.description: From a heavily textured white surface, a single eye looks out — framed in deep red, iris in teal. Raw, intimate, and quietly unsettling. A study in isolation and visibility.
works.alt: Mixed media — an eye on textured canvas

works.title: Rider
works.description: A woman rides through a world of flat colour and flowing form — terracotta, teal, off-white. A painting about freedom, movement, and the body in motion through an invented landscape.
works.alt: Painting — woman riding a horse in flat colour

works.title: Intimacy
works.description: Hands hold a strip of fabric against warm ochre bodies. The everyday becomes tender. A small painting about the quiet intimacy of ordinary moments and the eroticism of the mundane.
works.alt: Figurative painting — hands and fabric

works.title: Commissioned Portrait
works.description: A woman holds a white bird against her chest, crowned by a golden halo on a dusty pink ground. Painted as a commission, this piece celebrates the sacred in the everyday feminine.
works.alt: Commissioned portrait — woman with halo

works.title: Afternoon Nap
works.description: A man sleeps in folds of white sheets while a black cat's tail curls into the frame. A quiet painting about rest, closeness, and the small company that keeps us.
works.alt: Painting — a man asleep on white sheets with a cat's tail

works.title: Grenade
works.description: A grenade nested in green leaves on a coral ground — something violent made almost decorative. A small canvas that sits between threat and bloom.
works.alt: Small painting — a grenade among green leaves on coral pink

works.title: Horned Crown
works.description: A woman's face emerges from dense carved lines beneath a horned skull. Ancestral, watchful, and crowned by the animal above her.
works.alt: Linoprint — a woman beneath a horned skull

works.title: Fox & Moon
works.description: A woman and a fox lean into one another under a crescent moon, leaves drifting at their feet. Another meeting of the feminine and the wild, cut by hand.
works.alt: Linoprint — a woman and a fox under a crescent moon

works.title: Hair Brush
works.description: A tortoiseshell hair brush rests on a ruffled cream cloth against deep red — an everyday ritual object, drawn with the care of a still life.
works.alt: Illustration — a hair brush on a ruffled cloth against red

works.title: Camisa 7
works.description: A torso in Brazil's yellow number 7 shirt, one hand at the collar. Painted on loose canvas with a hand-stitched edge — part of a patchwork of memories of home.
works.alt: Painting — a torso in a yellow Brazil number 7 football shirt

works.title: Patchwork
works.description: Small painted canvases with stitched edges, laid together like a quilt: a football shirt, a Bonfim ribbon, a cross-stitched rose, a woman at a window. Fragments of Brazilian everyday life pieced into one surface.
works.alt: A patchwork of small stitched painted canvases laid out together

works.title: Senhor do Bonfim
works.description: A red Senhor do Bonfim da Bahia ribbon curls across a pale ground — the wish ribbon tied at the wrist in Salvador, painted as a quiet line of hope.
works.alt: Painting — a red Senhor do Bonfim da Bahia ribbon on a pale ground

works.title: Tropical Girl
works.description: A woman with a flower in her hair under strung lanterns and pineapples, carved in fine white lines on deep black. Hand-printed and framed.
works.alt: Framed linoprint — a woman with a flower in her hair under lanterns

works.title: Blush
works.description: Soft curves of rose and cream meet across the canvas — an abstract study of skin, warmth and the body's gentle edges.
works.alt: Abstract painting — curving shapes in rose pink and cream

works.title: Ochre
works.description: A warm ochre form flows between cream edges — a companion to Blush, built from the same quiet curves in an earthier key.
works.alt: Abstract painting — a flowing ochre shape between cream curves

works.title: The Eye II
works.technique: Acrylic and texture paste on canvas
works.description: A brown eye ringed in soft pink looks out from a heavily textured white surface — a return to The Eye, warmer and more direct.
works.alt: Mixed media — a brown eye ringed in pink on textured white

works.title: Isabela Lemos Personal Trainer
works.description: Isabela Lemos is a Brazilian personal trainer based in Amsterdam. Her visual identity shows a human body in movement — representing her individual PT sessions and the evolution that comes from that movement. The icon grew from sketches merging her initials, I and L, and pairs with her name in a simple typeface.
works.alt: Isabela Lemos business cards with the IL signature mark

works.title: Guidemi
works.description: Guidemi is a Brazilian brand officially born in Amsterdam. Mi Alves is a world traveller, and with this new brand she shares travel tips and products with her followers. She was looking for a simple yet classy logo design.
works.alt: Guidemi logotype printed on a white mug

works.title: Wedding Design
works.description: Wedding stationery drawn by hand — a save-the-date, invitation and table cards framed in loose botanical line work, with playful extras for the celebration.
works.alt: Hand-illustrated wedding invitation with a floral border

works.title: Buttersweet.
works.description: Buttersweet is a brand of home-baked goods from Amsterdam. The owner was looking for a cute yet simple design for the launch of the brand’s new website.
works.alt: Buttersweet business cards on a stone surface

works.title: Arigatou Ramen
works.description: A personal project. The word “arigatou” is linked to the Buddhist idea that one should always be appreciative, and one theory traces it to the Portuguese “obrigado”. This fictional ramen place takes the name because it is so good you will be thankful after eating.
works.alt: Arigatou Ramen card standing on a pink cloth

works.title: NUUH!
works.description: NUUH is a very common expression from Minas Gerais, Brazil — untranslatable, but something like “wow”. NUUH! is an artisan confectionery in São Paulo run by an artist and attorney. The new identity keeps the typography simple and makes the visuals colourful and cute, introducing the owner to those who don’t know her yet.
works.alt: NUUH! cards illustrated with the owner’s portrait

works.title: DALE
works.description: DALE is a semi-precious jewellery brand based in São Paulo, Brazil.
works.alt: DALE semi-jewellery business card

works.title: Pandala
works.description: Pandala is an online stationery and art accessories store from São Paulo, Brazil. Its old identity was too colourful, so the new logo is a cute illustrated mark with colours chosen from the Brazilian stationery market.
works.alt: Pandala shopping bag on a peach background

works.title: Maria Doces
works.description: Maria Doces is a brand of homemade sweets by Maria. She was looking for a simple yet colourful visual identity to represent the brand’s pastries and cakes.
works.alt: Maria Doces business card resting on a stone with a sprig

works.title: SIK Music Producer
works.description: SIK is a Brazilian music producer and musician who wanted a simple identity that still showed the classic records he samples in contemporary songs. A vinyl disc and a bold typeface give the design its minimalist feel, alongside two illustrations made especially for him.
works.alt: SIK stickers and record sleeve
